origin: Blueprint v2.0 feasibility audit (audit2.py), run by the blueprint author on a GitHub mirror of ShanghaiT2DM (pre-2023-10-26 content)

algorithm.description: stratify by treated*2 + has_L1; within ascending stratum, sort patient ids as strings, shuffle with one shared numpy Generator, first int(round(frac_T*n)) -> T

known_caveats: Strata (treated, has-L1) were computed by the original audit on mirror data. figshare v5 adds rows to recordings 2003_0 and 2029_0, so the has-L1 stratum of patients 2003 and 2029 must be re-checked in S2. A stratum change would not invalidate the split (stratification only balances the partition), but it must be reported.
The treated flag is re-verified against the production medication parser in S3.
